name: BlastZone
summary:
BlastZone brings the classic charm of an old-school shooting gallery straight into VR—bright lights, fast action, and that “just one more try” feeling. Whether you're a seasoned sharpshooter or brand-new to VR, you’ll jump in instantly and have a blast.
